text: Someone called saying they're from my bank's fraud department. They knew my name and the last 4 digits of my card. They said they'd send me a code and I should read it back to them to stop a charge.

A woman called crying, saying she was my granddaughter and was arrested after a car accident. Then a man said he was her lawyer and I need to give $9,000 cash to a courier who will come to my house. He said there's a gag order so I can't tell anyone.
Got a call from 'PG&E' saying my power will be cut off in an hour unless I pay $600 over the phone with a prepaid card.
Someone from 'Medicare' called offering a free back brace and a genetic test kit. They just need my Medicare number to send it.
A recorded voice said there's a problem with my Amazon account and to press 1 to speak to an agent. I hung up.
A man said he's from Microsoft and my computer is sending out viruses. He wants me to go to my computer and install a program so he can fix it.
My pharmacy called to say my prescription is ready and asked if I want it delivered. They didn't ask for anything else.
The dentist's office called to move my cleaning from Tuesday to Wednesday at the same time.
My daughter called from her usual number to say she'd be late picking me up for the doctor.
Me llamó un hombre diciendo que era de inmigración y que me iban a deportar si no pagaba una multa de $1,500 con tarjetas de regalo hoy.
Có người gọi tự xưng là nhân viên ngân hàng, nói tài khoản của tôi bị hack và bảo tôi chuyển hết tiền sang một tài khoản an toàn.
Someone called about my car's extended warranty and wanted my credit card.
